notes: For the MVP, only PAID is treated as a successfully settled principal payment.

LATE payments have amount_paid > 0 in the raw data (the money was eventually received), but LATE is retained as a behavioral status and deliberately excluded from the portfolio balance calculation. This is an MVP simplification, not a claim that late-paid amounts were never collected.
MISSED, FAILED, and SCHEDULED payments have amount_paid == 0 and never count toward successful payments.
A future iteration may enrich this rule so LATE payments count once flagged as received, at which point this file -- not the transformation code -- is where that change belongs.
